display_perimeters.geometry_semantics: Display-only simplification of final perimeters; metrics use unsimplified geometries.

method.grid: Existing 25 km authalic sinusoidal equal-area grid.
method.harmonized_spatial_prediction: NOT_EVALUATED: B1/B2 calibrate scalar monthly activity, not perimeters.
method.intersection_rule: Reference union intersects at least 1.00% of a grid-cell area.
method.temporal_evaluation: NOT_EVALUATED: final perimeters have no progression dates.

reference.coverage_semantics: Final fire perimeters; no dated fire progression.
reference.dataset: California Fire Perimeters 2020 / Burn areas layer
limitations: CAL FIRE states the historical perimeter database is incomplete.
Final perimeters do not establish daily observation opportunity or ignition timing.
The reference is an external perimeter product, not ground truth.
reference.publisher: California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection, FRAP
